news.title: Source: Red Wings' Dylan Larkin stretches list of trade options to 10 teams
news.ruTitle: Источник: Дилан Ларкин из Red Wings расширяет список вариантов обмена до 10 команд.
news.description: Dylan Larkin, whose trade request was made public last June, has told the Red Wings he'd be willing to move to at least seven additional teams, bringing his list of options to 10, a source confirmed to ESPN.

news.title: NFLPA calls for 'full investigation' into medical care provided to Eagles' Hurts
news.ruTitle: НФЛПА призывает провести «полное расследование» медицинской помощи, оказанной Eagles' Hurts
news.description: After NFL chief medical officer Allen Sills staunchly defended the process involving Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts and his blood clot issue on Tuesday, the NFLPA issued a statement calling for a "full investigation" into his medical care.
